messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2026-01-27] standup/boreal/2026-01-27: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-03-27] standup/cinder/2025-03-27: Rotation day for Cinder: Yuki hands the pager to Diego Alvarez.
- [2026-05-27] standup/ember/2026-05-27: Heads-up from team Ember: notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-11-11] standup/boreal/2025-11-11-2: Heads-up from team Boreal: the event bus' CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-11-25] standup/cinder/2025-11-25: Team Cinder on-call swapped this morning. Diego carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03: On-call rotation: Farah Haddad is primary for Dune starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-notifier: Notifier has a new home: the Cinder team. Boreal kept it until today.
- [2025-11-13] standup/boreal/2025-11-13: The reporting service still relies on the bus; keep that in mind for the maintenance.
- [2025-04-11] handover/2025-04-11-webhooks: Quick one: webhooks belongs to team Ember starting today. Thanks to Boreal for running it until now.
- [2025-09-24] standup/boreal/2025-09-24: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena today.
- [2025-05-21] standup/boreal/2025-05-21: Lena picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Marcus today.
- [2025-01-09] standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3: Marcus is on call for the Boreal team to start the year.
- [2025-11-19] handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer: From today the pager for image-resizer rings the Boreal team, not Cinder. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-07-09] standup/boreal/2025-07-09: Marcus picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: From today the pager for the event-bus rings the Boreal team, not team Dune. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-11-18] handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer: Handover: as of today the indexer moves from Boreal to Ember. Marcus walked Oskar through the runbook this morning.
- [2025-11-07] standup/boreal/2025-11-07: We agreed today that search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. The reason is that incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes.
- [2026-01-02] standup/boreal/2026-01-02: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-11-12] standup/boreal/2025-11-12: The catalog service's deploy window changes today: it is now on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. The old slot (Mondays 10:00-12:00 UTC) is retired.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for billing-api: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season). Observation from the Atlas team: after Tuesday's deploy, search-indexer's p99 latency doubled.
- [2025-08-13] standup/boreal/2025-08-13: The search indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. Reminder that reporting depends on the ledger.
- [2026-02-04] standup/boreal/2026-02-04: Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Lena carries the phone until the next rotation. Boreal saw that scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-10-27] incident-review/INC-2025-023: Review of INC-2025-023 (the search indexer, 2025-10-24). The root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk. We decided that reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.
- [2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-11-10] standup/ember/2025-11-10: Heads-up from team Ember: the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-11-03] standup/dune/2025-11-03-2: For newcomers: the deploy window for the job scheduler is still on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays.
- [2025-02-13] standup/boreal/2025-02-13: The notifier calls the event-bus for delivery events, so treat the event-bus as a hard dependency of the notifier. Dependency map update: webhooks needs the event-bus (outbound events).
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11-2: Observation from team Ember: after the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
